philosophy.title: The balance between hedonistic pleasure and real wellbeing.
philosophy.text: Eating well never means compromising on taste. At MUNCHOS we believe culinary delight and nutritional balance belong on the same plate — which is why we choose top-tier ingredients, gentle cooking techniques, and design every menu thoughtfully without sacrificing a single bit of flavor.

points.title: No refined oils
points.desc: We exclusively use cold-pressed Extra Virgin Olive Oil (EVOO).

points.title: Low in sugar
points.desc: We honor the natural sweetness of seasonal vegetables and fruits.

points.title: Clean & light protein
points.desc: Wild Cantabrian fish and lean meats prepared to perfection.

guarantee.title: Absolute Quality & Punctuality Guarantee.
guarantee.subtitle: Your peace of mind is the main ingredient of our catering.

cards.title: Guaranteed Punctuality
cards.desc: We arrive 45 minutes prior for setup. If delayed over 15 minutes without force majeure, we refund 20% of the total cost.

cards.title: 100% Freshness & Hygiene
cards.desc: Strict cold-chain maintenance and certified thermal transport. If any dish fails to meet expectations, we replace it immediately.

cards.title: 24h Claim Management
cards.desc: Direct line to management. Response and financial resolution or replacement within 24 business hours.

reviews.name: Elena R.
reviews.comment: MUNCHOS turned my living room into an elegant Donostia tavern. The cod pinchos and Balfegó nigiris vanished in minutes. My German guests were thrilled.

reviews.name: Markus & Sofía
reviews.comment: We were looking for catering that wasn't heavy or greasy. The balance of dishes and immaculate presentation won us over.

reviews.name: Carlos M.
reviews.comment: German punctuality with authentic Basque flavor. The live chef service was worth every euro. The La Viña-style cheesecake is unbeatable.
